why: Porous single-use items can hold germs where disinfectant cannot safely reach. They must be discarded after every client.
多孔的一次性用品会在消毒剂难以安全到达的部位藏住微生物，因此每位客户使用后都必须丢弃。
lock: porous = single use; hard reusable items may be disinfected.
多孔 = 一次性；坚硬的可重复使用用品可进行消毒。
refs: Milady Standard Foundations - Infection Control - Multiuse and Single-Use Items

why: A parasite lives on or inside another organism and takes nourishment from it. That supporting organism is called the host.
parasite（寄生虫）生活在另一生物体表面或体内，并从中获取营养。提供生存条件的生物称为 host（宿主）。
lock: parasite depends on a host.
parasite 依赖 host 生存。
refs: Milady Standard Foundations - Infection Control - Parasites

why: Redness, swelling, pus, and pain can signal infection or serious tissue irritation. Nail technicians must stop the service and refer the client for medical care.
发红、肿胀、流脓和疼痛可能表示感染或严重组织刺激。美甲师必须停止服务，并转介客户接受医疗处理。
lock: infection signs = no service; medical referral.
出现感染迹象 = 不提供服务；转介医疗人员。
refs: Nail Structure, Disorders, and Diseases - Diseases of the Nail

why: OSHA sets and enforces workplace safety and health standards. It also requires employers to communicate chemical hazards and provide required protection.
OSHA（职业安全与健康管理局）制定并执行工作场所安全与健康标准，也要求雇主说明化学危害并提供必要防护。
lock: OSHA = workplace safety and health enforcement.
OSHA = 执行工作场所安全与健康标准。
refs: Milady Standard Foundations - Infection Control - Federal Agencies

why: An item that cannot be cleaned and disinfected safely cannot move between clients. It is classified as single-use and discarded after service.
无法安全清洁和消毒的用品不能在客户之间重复使用，应归为一次性用品，并在服务后丢弃。
lock: cannot disinfect = single use.
无法消毒 = 一次性使用。
refs: Milady Standard Foundations - Infection Control - Single-Use Items

why: The femur runs from the hip to the knee. It is the longest and strongest bone in the body and the largest bone of the leg.
femur（股骨）从髋部延伸到膝部，是人体最长、最强壮的骨骼，也是腿部最大的骨骼。
lock: femur = thigh bone, hip to knee.
femur = 从髋部到膝部的大腿骨。
refs: General Anatomy and Physiology - Bones of the Leg and Foot

why: Polymerization links many small monomer molecules into long polymer chains. This curing reaction releases energy and may produce noticeable heat.
polymerization（聚合反应）把许多小的单体分子连接成长聚合物链。固化时会释放能量，并可能产生明显热量。
lock: polymerization = monomers join and release heat.
polymerization = 单体连接并释放热量。
refs: Monomer Liquid and Polymer Powder Nail Enhancements - Polymerization

why: Leukonychia appears as white spots on the nail plate, often after minor injury to matrix cells. The spots grow forward with the plate.
leukonychia（白甲症）表现为甲板白点，常由甲母质细胞轻微受伤引起；白点会随甲板向前生长。
lock: leukonychia = white spots that grow out.
leukonychia = 会随指甲长出的白点。
refs: Nail Structure, Disorders, and Diseases - Nail Disorders

why: A blood-contaminated disposable item cannot be disinfected for reuse. Place it in the proper waste container immediately after the service.
被血液污染的一次性用品不能消毒后重复使用，应在服务后立即放入规定的废弃物容器。
lock: blood-contaminated disposable = discard safely.
沾血的一次性用品 = 安全丢弃。
refs: Milady Standard Foundations - Infection Control - Blood Exposure Procedure

why: The dermis is called true skin because it contains living tissue, nerves, blood vessels, glands, and support structures beneath the epidermis.
dermis（真皮）又称 true skin，因为它位于表皮下方，含有活体组织、神经、血管、腺体和支撑结构。
lock: dermis = living true skin below epidermis.
dermis = 表皮下方的活体真皮。
refs: Skin Structure, Disorders, and Diseases - Dermis

why: Salon products act mainly on the stratum corneum, the outer layer of dead keratin cells. They should not reach living skin layers.
沙龙产品主要作用于 stratum corneum（角质层），即最外层的死亡角蛋白细胞，不应进入活体皮肤层。
lock: salon products act on the stratum corneum.
沙龙产品作用于 stratum corneum。
refs: Skin Structure, Disorders, and Diseases - Epidermis

why: Specialized nail ligaments connect the nail bed and matrix to the underlying bone. This support keeps the nail unit securely positioned.
指甲的特殊韧带把甲床和甲母质连接到下方骨骼，为甲单位提供稳固支撑。
lock: specialized ligaments anchor nail bed to bone.
特殊韧带把甲床固定到骨骼。
refs: Nail Structure, Disorders, and Diseases - Specialized Ligaments

why: The horny layer, or stratum corneum, contains dead keratin cells. These surface cells are continually shed and replaced from below.
horny layer（角质层）即 stratum corneum，由死亡的角蛋白细胞组成；表面细胞持续脱落，并由下层细胞补充。
lock: horny layer = stratum corneum = shedding surface.
horny layer = stratum corneum = 持续脱落的表层。
refs: Skin Structure, Disorders, and Diseases - Layers of the Epidermis

why: The nail plate is produced in the matrix and moves forward over the nail bed. Its distal end extends beyond the fingertip as the free edge.
甲板在甲母质中形成，并沿甲床向前移动；末端超过指尖的部分就是 free edge（游离缘）。
lock: nail plate path: matrix to free edge.
甲板路径：从甲母质到游离缘。
refs: Nail Structure, Disorders, and Diseases - Nail Plate

why: pH measures acidity or alkalinity only in water-based solutions. Detergent mixes with water, while oils, polish, and monomer are not measured this way.
pH 只用于测量水性溶液的酸碱度。洗涤剂会与水混合，而油、指甲油和单体液不按这种方式测量。
lock: pH applies to water-based solutions.
pH 适用于水性溶液。
refs: Milady Standard Foundations - Chemistry - The pH Scale

why: The matrix forms the nail plate, so its shape guides the plate's natural curvature. A wider or curved matrix produces a matching plate form.
甲母质形成甲板，因此其形状决定甲板的天然弧度；较宽或较弯的甲母质会形成相应的甲板形态。
lock: plate curvature begins in the matrix.
甲板弧度始于甲母质。
refs: Nail Structure, Disorders, and Diseases - Matrix

why: Paronychia is a bacterial infection of tissue around the nail plate. Redness, swelling, pain, or pus requires medical referral.
paronychia（甲沟炎）是甲板周围组织的细菌感染。若有发红、肿胀、疼痛或流脓，应转介医疗人员。
lock: paronychia = bacterial infection around the nail.
paronychia = 指甲周围的细菌感染。
refs: Nail Structure, Disorders, and Diseases - Overview of Nail Diseases

why: Matrix cells create the plate and determine its basic dimensions. Health affects growth quality and speed, but matrix structure controls shape.
甲母质细胞形成甲板并决定其基本尺寸。健康状况会影响生长质量和速度，但甲母质结构控制形状。
lock: health affects growth; matrix controls dimensions.
健康影响生长；甲母质控制尺寸和形状。
refs: Nail Structure, Disorders, and Diseases - Nail Growth and Matrix

why: A catalyst speeds a chemical reaction without becoming part of the finished product. In nail systems, it helps control curing time.
catalyst（催化剂）会加快化学反应，但不会成为最终产品的一部分；在美甲系统中，它帮助控制固化时间。
lock: catalyst = speeds a reaction.
catalyst = 加快化学反应。
refs: Monomer Liquid and Polymer Powder Nail Enhancements - Catalysts and Initiators

why: The supinator rotates the radius outward so the palm faces upward. A pronator turns the hand inward so the palm faces down.
supinator（旋后肌）使桡骨向外旋转，让手掌朝上；pronator（旋前肌）使手向内转，让手掌朝下。
lock: supinator = palm up; pronator = palm down.
supinator = 手掌向上；pronator = 手掌向下。
refs: General Anatomy and Physiology - Muscles of the Shoulder and Arm
